fusions.name: Weighted Net
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted net that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Drawstring Snare
fusions.desc: Pulls a hidden net shut around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Drapes
fusions.desc: Drops a 5-tile curtain ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Trapper's Mesh
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
